text:
Priya: Noticed a ledger gap after the midnight cutover. A handful of invoices show as "Unmatched" in NetSuite but Stripe shows payments. Looks like a batch failover happened during the posting window.
Emily: Which accounts + amounts?
Priya: ACCT-909 ($410), ACCT-334 ($120), ACCT-772 ($75). NetSuite refs: INV-909-0306 (Unmatched), INV-334-0306 (Unmatched). Stripe payment IDs present: pi_3Lx... for ACCT-909 etc.
Josh: I pulled the infra logs: at 2026-04-02T00:02Z the billing-batch-worker node A failed healthcheck and the job manager retried on node B. The db row lock for posting was held transiently so node B assumed the posting step didn't complete and retried the materialize step, creating duplicate NS create attempts. Our idempotency key is billing_job_run:{job_id}:{invoice.number} but node B had a different job_run_id. NetSuite responded 409 once and we retried with adjusted external_id which created a second placeholder record flagged "unmatched" by the ledger integrator.
billing-bot: infra:job-retry noticed worker-failover for billing-post at 2350012350 :warning:
Emily: So failover plus job_run_id variance caused mismatched external_id and left an unlinked placeholder in NS. Is the cash impacted?
Netsuite-admin: The placeholder invoices are unposted and in Pending status. GL not yet impacted. I can merge the placeholder into the real invoice if we have the original external_id mapping, but I'll need engineering to provide the canonical stripe_invoice_id -> ns_internal_id map.
Priya: Good that GL not hit. We still need a quick remediation and a longer-term fix.
Josh: Quick remediation plan:
1) Extract canonical mapping from event-store for the affected Stripe invoice ids and provide to NS admin (10m).
2) NS admin will merge/void the placeholder invoices and link payments to the correct invoice (requires NS change ticket for merging)
3) Hotfix: change idempotency key to use stripe_invoice_id only (not job_run_id) and add a distributed lock around the posting step so failover doesn't run concurrent posts (30-45m).
Emily: Also add an alert when a NetSuite invoice is created with source_job_run different from the active job run for that invoice.number.
Netsuite-admin: I'll hold the placeholders in Pending and open a merge ticket once you provide the mapping.
Priya: Approve NS merge/void for amounts <= $500. ACCT-909 is $410 so approved. For >$500 we'd need CFO sign-off.
Josh: I'll produce the mapping now. Command I used to pull events: `pg_dumpquery "select stripe_invoice_id, ns_id, job_run from billing_events where stripe_invoice_id in ('in_9...','in_2...')"`
Josh: Pushed mapping file to FIN-3652 and pinged Netsuite-admin.
billing-bot: file:FIN-3652 created by josh at 2350012399 :file_folder:
Netsuite-admin: Received mapping and merged INV-909-0306 into INV-909 canonical at 2350012415. Payments remapped.
Priya: Confirm ledger exposure now?
Netsuite-admin: Ledger balanced, placeholders voided, no GL impact. Posted merge note in FIN-3652.
Emily: For the long term I'll open PR for idempotency and a small runbook: if node fails during posting, job manager should wait for lock release and revalidate external_id before attempting create.
Josh: Opening PR fix/idempotency-lock (link: https://git.example.com/r/redwood/billing/pulls/458). Also adding a smoke test that simulates node failover during posting.
billing-bot: deploy:hotfix/idempotency-lock created by josh at 2350012445, CI queued :rocket:
Priya: Owners: Josh (code + mapping), Netsuite-admin (merge + void), Emily (alerts + runbook). Target: mapping provided and merges done now; PR and tests in follow-up.
Emily: Adding saved search: NetSuite invoices in Pending with source_job_run != active_job_run OR external_id contains ":failover". Alerts to Priya + Emily.
Netsuite-admin: Saved search created and alert rule set at 2350012458.
Priya: Thanks all. Closing when PR merges and saved search proves useful in 24h.
